name: Shamane
bio: Archetype: DEF Debuff, Splash ST DPT. ⌽ Skill 2 inflicts DEF reduction and DMG taken increase. ⌽ Stores Moxie with Tier 2+ Skill 1 & every 2 turns, allowing faster Ultimate cycling. ⌽ Ultimate is an ST nuke with splash damage; ST-AoE hybrid. ⌽ Skill 2 synergizes with Insight 1 for more damage.
